query: 首席独立董事 首席独立董事 衡量企业是否设立首席独立董事（或资深独立董事）职位的制度化程度及其实际发挥的监督作用。重点考察其授权范围、召集权、对董事长的制衡能力及履职透明度。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越/高分）：设有首席独立董事；具备明确的职权清单（如：在董事长缺席或回避时主持会议、批准董事会会议日程）；拥有独立召集权（可定期在无内部董事参与的情况下召集独董会议）；并详细披露了年度履职报告或具体贡献。 • 1分（合格/中低分）：名义上设立了首席独立董事或类似职位，但在公司章程或治理报告中缺乏具体的职权边界说明，且未见其独立行使召集权或监督权的实质记录。 • 0分（不合格）：未设立首席独立董事，或在董事长与 CEO 合一的情况下未建立任何抵消性的独立治理机制。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：首席独立董事的职权已正式写入《公司章程》或《董事会议事规则》，且覆盖集团所有核心治理决策环节。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：仅在个别委员会（如审计委）中发挥牵头作用，或仅作为临时性安排，未形成制度化的长效机制。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关制度覆盖。 首席独立董事 资深独立董事 首席独立非执行董事 独董召集人 召集独董会议 纯独董会议 批准董事会议程 制衡董事长 股东沟通联系人 履职报告 SID LID Lead Independent Director Senior Independent Director Lead Independent Non-Executive Director LID SID convene independent directors independent directors-only meeting executive session board agenda approval checks on the chair shareholder liaison 是否设立首席独立董事、资深独立董事或实质等同职位？ 职权是否包括主持会议、批准或建议议程？ 可否在无执行董事或管理层参与下召集独董会议？ 是否作为股东与董事会沟通联系人并制衡董事长？ 是否披露年度履职？ 职权是否写入章程、议事规则或治理文件？

results.section: 合規經營，誠信為先 / Enhancing Compliance Governance and Upholding Integrity
results.text: During the Year, the Group continued to improve the anti-corruption complaint and reporting mechanism. In order to ensure the smooth channels of complaint and reporting, the Compliance Department added or updated the anti-corruption complaint board in the prominent positions of the Group's headquarters, 28 subsidiaries and marketing centers, and received violation reporting through telephone, e-mail, letters and other channels. After receiving a reporting, the Compliance Department of the Group will evaluate the authenticity of the reporting content according to the reporting acceptance procedures, confirm whether there are violations, and will give an initial reply to the whistleblower according to the evaluation results. Meanwhile, the Department will investigate the contents of the reporting, understand the situation and collect evidence through conversation, and summarize the investigation results through reports and submit them to the management of the Group. If the violation is true, the Group will impose corresponding punishment according to the provisions of the employee manual. If the circumstances are particularly serious, the suspected offender will be transferred to the public security agencies for handling. In order to protect the legitimate rights and interests of the whistleblower and prevent retaliation against the whistleblower, the Group has listed in detail the regulations on the protection of the whistleblower in the 'Complaint and Reporting System', and will strictly keep the whistleblower's information confidential. In 2021, no litigation in regard to corruption was filed against the Group.

results.text: In order to create a safe and healthy working environment, we have also formulated the 'Form for Identification of Hidden Safety Risk and Hazard' to standardize the content and legal basis of hidden danger investigation from the aspects of basic management, general plans, equipment and instrumentation, electric, emergency and fire protection, and hazardous chemicals, to provide subsidiaries with a reference basis for the hidden danger investigation. Among them, Ambest Pharmaceutical performed outstandingly in the special safety inspection of electrical system during the Year, which was selected by the Group as an outstanding EHS management case and promoted among all subsidiaries, standardizing the use and management of electrical equipment and improving the level of risk prevention.

results.text: In addition, for the special positions - pharmaceutical representatives, based on the national version of record-filing management of pharmaceutical representatives, the Group has formulated the 'Administrative Measures for Record-filing of Pharmaceutical Representatives of Sihuan Group (Trial)', which has carried out detailed constraints and specifications from the definition of work content, professional qualifications, management requirements, response plans, etc. It strictly prohibits commercial bribery such as 'rebate marketing' so as to ensure that marketing activities are carried out for the academic purpose.
